items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: like we brought in Jock Carruthers, you know, sent to Kansas City and brought him in.

ctx.x: So I remember once when he needed a trombone player, he was going to try a trombone player, so right away I said Dickie Wells. So he said, "No, I don't want no New York musicians. I have to get somebody else, you know." You know, it was funny about that, he'd always send somewhere
else, you know, like we brought in Jock Carruthers, you know, sent to Kansas City and brought him in.
Well, maybe he thought they'd be a little too hip to work like that.
